instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 1 of the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Establish the "System of Record" identity and the "Infrastructure Layer" (Module 2.1) upon which all agency operations will sit.

section.title: 1. Platform & Infrastructure (The App Shell)
section.requirement: Initialize Supabase client and environment configuration. Use Supabase Auth exclusively; no local password hashing.
Implement a standard base schema for all future tables: id (UUID), created_at, updated_at, and created_by.
Implement stateless token-based authentication (AUTH-02). - Access Token: 1-hour expiration. - Refresh Token: 7-day expiration.
Create the side navigation shell. Include links for: Clients, Workflows, and Blockers (link to "Coming Soon" states).

section.title: 2. Authentication & Identity (Core Logic)
section.requirement: Implement the four defined roles: Super Admin, Project Manager, Team Member, Client.
Implement route guards to enforce role-based permissions and prevent unauthorized access (AC-03).
Global state propagation for current user: name, role, and avatar_url.
Mechanism to invalidate session, clear local storage, and revoke tokens on logout.

section.title: 3. Internal Dashboard Shell (MVP View)
section.requirement: Create reusable UI components for top-row metrics (Active Clients, Workflows, etc.).
Establish global patterns for loading states, API error normalization, and empty states.

logic.description: Admin Initialization Path: Since admins create accounts, provide a seed script or a basic Admin-only POST /api/auth/register endpoint to bootstrap the first users.
JWT Refresh Mechanism: Implement silent refresh logic immediately. Ensure users are not logged out upon 1-hour access token expiration.

item.req: App Shell + Side Nav + Metric Stubs

instruction.first_principles_check: Ensure the "Identity Boundary" is robust. Every action must be auditable (created_by) and restricted (RBAC) from the first commit to avoid architectural rewrites in later slices.
